description: RAPID Collaborative Research: Spatial variability of small-strain stiffness and the effect on ground movements related to geotechnical construction in urban areas (numerical analysis) is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Richard Finno, Northwestern University (northwestern.edu). This collaborative project investigates the variability of small strain and the effect on ground movements related to geotechnical construction in urban areas. For this, we quantified the effects of the spatial variability found on computed ground movements and relate these movements to those measured on the site. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Seattle Clay, Excavation, Triaxial Test, PLAXIS. Published 2020-06-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
